questions.q: Why does groundwater depletion often go unnoticed, according to the passage?
o: Because it is measured every year
questions.x: Answer: 'Because groundwater cannot be seen'. The passage states: 'Because it cannot be seen, its depletion goes unnoticed'. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Groundwater is India's hidden reservoir, supplying most of the water used for irrigation and drinking. Because it cannot be seen, its depletion goes unnoticed until wells run dry. Free electricity for pumps has made extraction almost costless, encouraging farmers to grow water-hungry crops even in dry regions. Recharge, meanwhile, has fallen as ponds are filled and land is paved. Unless pricing, crop choices and recharge are addressed together, the reservoir beneath our feet may empty faster than rain can refill it.

questions.q: Which measure does the author suggest?
o: Addressing pricing, crop choices and recharge together
questions.x: Answer: 'Addressing pricing, crop choices and recharge together'. The last sentence recommends an integrated approach. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Groundwater is India's hidden reservoir, supplying most of the water used for irrigation and drinking. Because it cannot be seen, its depletion goes unnoticed until wells run dry. questions.q: In an economy, GDP at market prices is ₹2,70,000 crore, net factor income from abroad is ₹1,000 crore and depreciation is ₹17,000 crore. NNP at market prices is:
Office furniture is purchased for ₹1,80,000. Its estimated useful life is 10 years with a residual value of ₹6,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (1,80,000 − 6,000) / 10 = 1,74,000 / 10 = ₹17,400 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: A royalty agreement providing a 'minimum rent' gives rise to 'short workings' when:
o: No production occurs at all in the year only
Actual royalty is less than the minimum rent
Actual royalty exceeds the minimum rent
questions.x: Short workings may be recouped from future excess royalties within a stated period.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 2.5 : 1 and its working capital is ₹2,47,500. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 2.5x and working capital = 2.5x − x = 1.5x.
1.5x = 2,47,500 → x = ₹1,65,000.
Current assets = 2.5 × 1,65,000 = ₹4,12,500.

questions.q: 'GAAP' stands for:
questions.x: GAAP are the rules and conventions followed in preparing financial statements.

questions.q: The Securities Premium account can be used for all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.x: Section 52 of the Companies Act lists permitted uses; dividend cannot be paid from securities premium.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹1,18,000, selling price is ₹200 per unit and variable cost is ₹180 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 200 − 180 = ₹20.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 1,18,000 / 20 = 5,900 units.

questions.q: Internal audit differs from statutory audit mainly because internal audit is:
o: Mandated for every company by the CAG
Conducted by persons appointed by management to review controls and operations
questions.x: Internal audit is a management tool; the Companies Act requires it for certain classes of companies.

questions.x: Correct answer: Constant. SLM charges an equal amount annually.

questions.q: Under the traditional golden rules, for a real account the rule is:
o: Debit the giver, credit the receiver
Debit all expenses and losses, credit all incomes and gains
Debit what comes in, credit what goes out
Debit the receiver, credit the giver

questions.q: A partner's capital on 1 April was ₹1,50,000. The partner introduced additional capital of ₹10,000 on 1 October (financial year ends 31 March). Interest on capital is allowed at 6% p.a. The interest for the year is:
questions.x:
Interest on opening capital = 1,50,000 × 6% = ₹9,000.
Additional capital earns interest for 6 months = 10,000 × 6% × 6/12 = ₹300.
Total = ₹9,300.

questions.q: The maximum number of partners in a partnership firm under the Companies (Miscellaneous) Rules, 2014 is:
questions.x: The Companies Act, 2013 empowers rules; the limit is 50 partners.

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 150 units @ ₹17; 10th — 100 units @ ₹18; 20th — 300 units @ ₹21. 250 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 300 units left come from the latest purchases: 300 × ₹21 = ₹6,300.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹40,000 is depreciated at 25% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 40,000 × (0.75)^2 = ₹22,500.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹20,000.)

questions.q: The OSH Code prohibits employment of contract labour in core activities of an establishment, except in certain situations. Which of the following is one such exception?

The normal functioning of the establishment is such that the activity is ordinarily done through contractors
The establishment is a listed company
The contract workers earn more than permanent workers

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) offers life cover of:

questions.q: An employee retires after 8 years of continuous service. Last drawn monthly wages (basic + DA) are ₹22,000. Gratuity payable under the statutory formula (non-seasonal establishment) is:
questions.x:
Gratuity = 15/26 × last drawn wages × completed years of service.
= 15/26 × 22,000 × 8 = ₹1,01,538 (well within the ₹20 lakh ceiling).
The divisor 26 reflects working days in a month.

questions.q: An eligible employee earns ₹18,000 per month. The notified minimum wage for the employment is ₹6,000 per month. If the establishment declares bonus at 8.33%, the annual bonus payable is (statutory computation):
questions.x:
For computing bonus, salary is capped at ₹7,000 or the minimum wage, whichever is higher: max(7,000, 6,000) = ₹7,000.
Salary for computation = min(18,000, 7,000) = ₹7,000.
Annual bonus = 7,000 × 12 × 8.33% = ₹6,997. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: The 'Employees' Family Pension Scheme' under the EPF Act was introduced in:
questions.x: It provided family pension on death in service and was replaced by EPS 1995.

questions.q: 'One Nation One Ration Card' enables:

questions.x: Correct answer: Beneficiaries to draw their entitled foodgrains from any fair price shop in the country. Portability of NFSA entitlements helps migrant workers.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Employers cannot deduct their own share of EPF contribution from employees' wages.
Reason (R): The EPF & MP Act makes the employer liable to pay both shares to EPFO and permits recovery of only the employee share from wages.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. Section 8A permits recovery of only the employee's share from wages; the employer's share is its own liability.

questions.q: Gratuity is primarily a:
o: Reward for long and continuous service paid on separation
questions.x: Correct answer: Reward for long and continuous service paid on separation. Gratuity is a terminal benefit for long service.

questions.q: The Social Security Act of the United States was enacted in 1935 as part of:

questions.q: The maximum assurance benefit under the EDLI Scheme (since 2021) is:

questions.q: Dependants' benefit under ESI, paid when an insured person dies from employment injury, is shared among dependants at what rate of wages?

o: American Standard Code for Information Interchange

questions.x: India became the first nation to reach Mars orbit on its maiden attempt.

questions.x: Goitre results from lack of Iodine.

questions.q: Which radiation is used in the sterilisation of medical equipment and treatment of cancer?
questions.x: Gamma rays have very high energy.

questions.q: The causative agent of dengue is:
o: Dengue virus (a flavivirus spread by Aedes mosquitoes)
Wuchereria bancrofti (nematode worm, spread by Culex mosquitoes)
questions.x: Dengue: Dengue virus (a flavivirus spread by Aedes mosquitoes).

questions.q: The chemical name/formula of 'dry ice' is:
questions.x: Dry ice = Solid CO₂.

questions.q: Theory of evolution by natural selection is credited to:
questions.x: Theory of evolution by natural selection: Charles Darwin.

questions.q: The SI unit of capacitance is the:
questions.x: Capacitance is measured in Farads.

questions.q: Which key combination switches between open applications in Windows?
questions.x: Correct answer: Alt + Tab. Ctrl + Tab switches between tabs within an application.

questions.q: One byte consists of:
questions.x: Correct answer: 8 bits. A nibble is 4 bits.

questions.q: Which gas is filled in electric bulbs to prolong filament life?
questions.x: Correct answer: Argon (or nitrogen). Inert gases prevent oxidation of the tungsten filament.

questions.q: Three bells toll at intervals of 20, 6, 45 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(20, 6, 45) seconds.
LCM = 180 s = 3 min.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 26, 31, 39, 50, 64, ?
questions.x: Differences are 5, 8, 11, 14 — increasing by 3. Next difference = 17, so next term = 64 + 17 = 81.

questions.q: The average weight of 9 parcels is 35 kg. When one more parcel is added, the average becomes 38 kg. The weight of the new parcel is:
questions.x:
Old total = 9 × 35 = 315 kg. New total = 10 × 38 = 380 kg.
New parcel = 380 − 315 = 65 kg.
Shortcut: new value = new average + (increase × old count) = 38 + 3 × 9 = 65 kg.

questions.q: What simple interest will ₹14,000 earn in 2 years at 7.5% per annum?
A cyclist rides from town P to town Q at 18 km/h and returns along the same road at 54 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 18 × 54 / (18 + 54) = 1944/72 = 27 km/h.

questions.q: Meena starts from point O and walks 5 km towards South, then turns left and walks 7 km, then turns right and walks 3 km, and finally turns left and walks 8 km. How far is the person from O and in which direction?
questions.x:
Take O as origin, North/East positive.
North–South: -5 -3 = -8 km → 8 km South.
East–West: +7 +8 = 15 km → 15 km East.
Distance = √(15² + 8²) = 17 km, towards South-East.

questions.q: In what ratio must coffee seeds costing ₹60 per kg be mixed with coffee seeds costing ₹210 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹123 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (210 − 123) : (123 − 60) = 87 : 63 = 29 : 21.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: In a line of trainees, Harish is 17th from the front and 13th from the back. How many persons are there in all?
questions.x: Total = (position from front) + (position from back) − 1 = 17 + 13 − 1 = 29. Harish is counted in both positions, hence −1.

questions.q: Find the compound interest on ₹21,000 for 2 years at 20% per annum, compounded annually.
questions.x:
Amount = P(1 + R/100)² = 21,000 × (1.2)² = ₹30,240.
CI = Amount − P = ₹9,240.
Check: SI for 2 years = ₹8,400; CI exceeds it by P(R/100)² = ₹840.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 5:45?
questions.x:
Angle = |30H − 5.5M| = |30×5 − 5.5×45| = |150 − 247.5| = 97.5°.
Smaller angle = 97.5°.
(The minute hand gains 5.5° per minute over the hour hand.)

questions.q: The marks of students are: 12, 84, 46, 72, 62, 77, 14. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 367; number of values = 7. Mean = 367/7 = 52.43.

questions.q: A trader buys an office chair for ₹1,350 and sells it for ₹1,458. His profit per cent is:
questions.x:
Profit = SP − CP = ₹1,458 − ₹1,350 = ₹108.
Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 = (108 / 1,350) × 100 = 8%.
(Profit % is always on cost price, not on selling price.)

questions.q: Two fair dice are thrown together. What is the probability that the sum of the numbers shown is 9?
